statement: CISA adds the Chrome V8 zero-day CVE-2026-87491, disclosed by Google on 2026-09-08 as exploited in the wild, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-23.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON feed contains an entry for CVE-2026-87491 with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-23 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-87491 is absent from the KEV catalog at the deadline, or its dateAdded value falls outside 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-23.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
